advice: err-BC-ERR-08019 serves the record's scoring_consequence about an answer point and a 2023 area point (sg-23:16), but ex-1 is an arc length setup with no answer point, and the BC-PT-99051 line in the same lesson says sg-26:19 requires the limits to be numerical but not correct for the form point. A student reading both gets two different consequences for the same wrong limit.

The lower limit 0 on x ln x makes the BC-ERR-08019 integral improper (the integrand is unbounded at 0), and the prose calls 0 'the left end of the domain of ln x' although 0 is not in that domain. The generator's wording, 'the start of the axis', is the more accurate account; chk-3 on x e^(x/4) has no such problem.
